descriptionHtml: Tech Theraphy is an interactive talk session with university students, on how to start an engineering project and get satisfying outcome from it.This is conducted by the undergraduates who performed remarkably in their projects, mainly with the intention of sharing the experience with their fellow undergraduates.The session revolves around key areas such as Selection, Project scope, feasibility, implementation and maintenance.
